verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a developer docs site with llms.txt, typed schemas, an MCP server and a docs assistant that maps tasks to endpoints. None of it documents an interactive API reference or runnable, try-it examples. The OpenAPI/Swagger probe returned 404 on every candidate path, so there is no machine-readable spec either. Typed schemas and the assistant are adjacent features, not the interactive reference the story asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
